You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you…
There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

people.name: Nebo_Mount
people.line: The mountain where Moses viewed the Promised Land

translations.web: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.
translations.bsb: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers have been crushed.
translations.kjv: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
translations.asv: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all thy lovers are destroyed.
